title: 第14章  斩杀魔神
slug: 爹仙尊娘魔尊我嘎嘎乱杀
content_zh:
谢莲心手中的剑爆发出了刺目无比的光芒，剑光冲天，撕裂虚空，狂暴的剑气带着气吞八荒，唯我独尊的剑意，一剑斩断了魔神的手，并且将他的巨大的身体也劈开了。
剑光中，映照出魔神惊恐的脸，被劈开的脸上，惊恐万分。
这、这剑意是……
天地轰鸣，剑光中魔神不甘地怒吼了一声：“不——”
在这破灭万邪的惊天剑意中，那劈开的两半巨大身体，灰飞烟灭了。残余的剑气化为了飓风，横扫四周，不知道多少的魔族一起化成了灰烬。
天幕直接都被斩成了两半，剑痕直接将天空给犁出一道巨大无比的漆黑沟壑。
战场上一片死寂！
太可怕了！
这一剑实在是太可怕了！
众人看着立在天空中的少女，仿佛看到了另一个高大的身影。那个站在仙盟最顶端的男人，仙盟第一绝世强者，让魔族闻风丧胆的玉阳仙尊。
这就是玉阳仙尊的剑气吗？
就算是魔神也就是一击而已。
他们又看着谢莲心，这个只有十四岁的少女，他们自问如果自己拥有玉阳仙尊的剑气，能击杀魔神吗？
答案是否定的。
他们刚刚甚至恐惧得身体都僵住了，面对魔神连战意都没有。而这个实力只有元婴期，年纪仅仅十四岁的少女无所畏惧地冲了上去。这一刻霍嫣跟其他高阶修士们一个个都感到羞愧不已。
谢莲心不愧是玉阳仙尊的徒弟！
这一刻众人都服了。
魔族们一瞬的震惊呆滞后，惊恐地掉头逃了。
这是什么怪物啊？
快逃啊！

“站住——”
谢莲心见魔族要逃，居然是就这么追了上去。
“谢师妹——”
霍嫣大喊了一声。
但是谢莲心她穿着鲲鹏羽衣，她的速度实在是太快了，羽衣上青色的霞光流转，一只鲲鹏的巨大虚影将谢莲心给笼罩住了。她眨眼间就跟着魔族一起冲入了红云隐藏的界门中，神识也无法感知到。
霍嫣脸色苍白如纸，居然冲进魔界，这也太莽了吧！
就算有宗主师伯的剑气，她才元婴期啊！
这可怎么办？
霍嫣有心去找谢莲心，但是要塞这里不能没人指挥，杜信已经陨落，她不能离开。防御大阵不修好，魔族迟早再来。她只能一边指挥众人继续修复阵法，一边让人立刻传讯给宗门。
实际上，早就有人传讯了，但距离原因，宗门那边还没收到。
通讯玉简、传讯符要实时传讯皆有距离限制，过长的距离，只能靠人来送信。
————
双月同天，月下的一片峡谷中传来厮杀的声音。身穿着鲲鹏羽衣的少女手握一把长剑，每一次挥剑就有大片的魔族被斩杀，血溅如雨，魔族的尸体堆积得如同小山一般。
魔族数量实在太多了，谢莲心不想跟他们继续缠斗下去了，于是撒出去一把爆破符，然后就用最快的速度朝着前面飞射而去。
轰隆隆，身后传来爆炸的声音，和魔族的惨叫声，她唇角微微勾起，身体化为了一道疾驰的青色流光，一下子到了万里之外。
忽地，一阵令人心惊的威压袭来，谢莲心心脏骤然一跳，立即就停下来。
头顶的双月忽然地被暗影遮住了，天空之上出现了一只长着四片羽翼的巨大怪鸟，这怪鸟拖着一条长长的红色尾巴，气息强悍无比，展翅的瞬间，掀起了恐怖的风暴。
魔神！！
巨大的怪鸟缩小了体型，变成一个妖娆的女子，这女子披着黑色的纱衣朝着谢莲心媚笑起来：“哪里来的小可爱，快，快过来，让姐姐好好地瞧瞧~”
她声音带着魅惑，可惜没有魅惑到谢莲心。

谢莲心不想浪费父亲的剑气去杀这魔神，扭头就朝着旁边飞去了。在鲲鹏羽衣的作用下，她的速度极快，瞬间消失在了这黑纱女子的眼中。黑纱女子面露惊讶，但那很快就媚笑着朝着谢莲心追去了：
“小家伙，你要去哪里啊？”
————
咻！咻！
一道青色的闪电从魔界奇形怪状的山峰间疾驰而过，后面跟着一道黑色的气。双方的速度都非常的快，一下子就出了数万里。
谢莲心虽然有鲲鹏羽衣但是这羽衣也需要消耗她的法力的，所以很快她的速度就慢了下来。
身后传来媚笑声，数千道的风刃朝着谢莲心袭来，谢莲心一边高速躲避，一边用手中的长剑斩出道道的剑芒反击。
只是她自身实力跟魔神相比差太远了，就算身上的法宝挂再多也没用。
难道又要浪费一道父亲的剑气吗？
轰隆隆——
黑纱女子大笑着，掀起了恐怖的风暴，四周的山峰在风暴中不断地崩塌下来，这风暴的范围非常的广阔，谢莲心无法逃出风暴范围，只能再次使用一道谢逸的剑气了。
她长剑爆发出刺目的光芒，那剑意让黑纱女子大吃一惊，白色的剑光横扫，宛若神龙摆尾，霎那间就将风暴碾压回去，狂风倒卷，漫天的沙暴中，传来了黑纱女子的一声惨叫。
死了没有？
谢莲心绷紧了神经。
风停了，一道身影立在天空中。
黑纱女子没有死，她身体上半身从左肩膀到胸口裂开了，谢逸的剑气让她的伤口无法愈合，但是她也没有死去，刚刚她避开了真正的要害。谢莲心未能一剑结果其性命，重伤的黑纱女子暴怒了。
“小贱人——”
暴怒的魔神甚是恐怖，她面目狰狞，全身爆发的而出的杀意形成的威压和气浪，瞬间将谢莲心给掀飞了出去。
砰砰砰——
谢莲心砸穿了三座山峰，她从地面一跃而起，因为鲲鹏羽衣和身上其他宝物的关系没有被重伤。但是她一起身，暴怒的魔神已经近前了，谢莲心挨了一拳头，再度被打飞，砸穿了又一座山峰。

这家伙的实力比要塞的那个魔神强，谢莲心心中闪过这念头。
魔族里面有低等魔族，高等魔族，高等魔族之上有魔神，而魔神的实力实际上千差万别，大大小小的魔神之上，是始祖魔神，也被称之为原初魔神。谢莲心的外公就是最强大的原初魔神之一。
她母亲是魔神和大妖的结合，继承了二分之一的原初魔神的力量，谢莲心一半是人类，四分之一为妖，四分之一是魔。
她继承了四分之一的原初魔神的力量，只是她出生没多久，原初魔神的力量连同四分之一的妖力都被她父亲给封印了。
content_en:
The sword in Xie Lianxin's hand burst out with a dazzling light. The sword light soared into the sky, tearing apart the void. The violent sword energy swallowed up all the wasteland with its anger. With the only sword intention, it cut off the devil's hand with one sword and split his huge body.
The demon's frightened face was reflected in the sword light, and the split face was full of horror.
This, this sword intention is...
The sky and the earth roared, and the demon god roared unwillingly in the sword light: "No--"
In this shocking sword intent that destroyed all evil, the two halves of the huge body were destroyed into ashes. The remaining sword energy turned into a hurricane, sweeping around and turning countless demons into ashes.
The sky was cut in half, and the sword marks plowed a huge black ravine in the sky.
There was deathly silence on the battlefield!
How terrible!
This sword is really terrifying!
Everyone looked at the girl standing in the sky and seemed to see another tall figure. The man who stood at the top of the Immortal Alliance, the most powerful person in the Immortal Alliance, the Yuyang Immortal Lord who made the demon clan fearful.
Is this the sword energy of Yuyang Immortal Lord?
Even if it's a demon, it's just one blow.
They looked at Xie Lianxin, a girl who was only fourteen years old, and asked themselves if they had the sword energy of Yuyang Immortal Lord, could they kill the devil?
The answer is no.
They were so frightened just now that their bodies froze, and they didn't even have the will to fight when facing the devil. And this girl, who was only at the Nascent Soul stage and only fourteen years old, rushed forward fearlessly. At this moment, Huo Yan and the other high-level monks all felt ashamed.
Xie Lianxin is worthy of being the disciple of Yuyang Immortal Lord!
At this moment everyone was convinced.
The demons were stunned for a moment, then turned around and ran away in horror.
What kind of monster is this?
Run away!
"Stop—"
Xie Lianxin saw that the demons were about to escape, so she actually chased after them.
"Thank you, junior sister——"
Huo Yan shouted.
But Xie Lianxin was wearing a Kunpeng feather robe, and her speed was too fast. The cyan glow on the feather robe flowed, and a huge phantom of Kunpeng enveloped Xie Lianxin. In the blink of an eye, she followed the demons and rushed into the hidden gate of Hongyun, and her spiritual consciousness could not detect it.
Huo Yan's face was as pale as paper, and she rushed into the demon world. This was too reckless!
Even with the sword energy of the sect leader and uncle, she is only at the Nascent Soul stage!
What can we do?
Huo Yan is determined to find Xie Lianxin, but the fortress cannot be left without command. Du Xin has fallen and she cannot leave. If the defensive array is not repaired, the demons will come back sooner or later. She could only direct everyone to continue repairing the formation while having someone immediately send a message to the sect.
In fact, someone had already sent the message, but due to the distance, the sect had not received it yet.
Communication jade slips and communication talismans have distance limits for real-time communication. If the distance is too long, people can only rely on people to deliver messages.
————
It was two moons on the same day, and the sound of fighting came from a canyon under the moon. The girl wearing Kunpeng feathers held a long sword in her hand. Every time she swung the sword, a large number of demons were killed, blood spattered like rain, and the bodies of the demons piled up like a hill.
There were too many demons, and Xie Lian didn't want to continue fighting with them, so she threw out a handful of explosive talismans and then flew forward as fast as she could.
Rumbling, the sound of explosions and the screams of the demons came from behind. The corners of her lips were slightly raised, and her body turned into a speeding blue stream of light, suddenly reaching thousands of miles away.
Suddenly, a frightening pressure came over. Xie Lian's heart skipped a beat and stopped immediately.
The twin moons above the head were suddenly covered by shadows, and a huge strange bird with four wings appeared in the sky. This strange bird dragged a long red tail, and its breath was extremely powerful. The moment it spread its wings, it set off a terrifying storm.
Demon! !
The huge strange bird shrank in size and turned into an enchanting woman. This womanZizi wore a black gauze dress and smiled charmingly at Xie Lian: "Where did you come from, little cutie? Come here, let me take a good look~"
Her voice was charming, but unfortunately it didn't charm Xie Lianxin.
Xie Lian didn't want to waste her father's sword energy to kill the demon, so she turned around and flew to the side. Under the influence of Kunpeng Yuyi, she moved extremely fast and instantly disappeared from the eyes of the black gauze woman. The woman in black gauze looked surprised, but she quickly chased after Xie Lianxin with a charming smile:
"Little guy, where are you going?"
————
Phew! call out!
A bolt of cyan lightning rushed through the strangely shaped peaks of the demon world, followed by a streak of black energy. Both sides were very fast, covering tens of thousands of miles in one go.
Although Xie Lianxin had Kunpeng Yuyi, the Yuyi also needed to consume her mana, so her speed soon slowed down.
There was a charming laugh from behind, and thousands of wind blades struck at Xie Lianxin. Xie Lianxin dodged at high speed and counterattacked with the long sword in her hand.
It's just that her own strength is far behind that of the Demon God, and it's useless no matter how many magic weapons she has on her body.
Are we going to waste another piece of father's sword energy?
Rumble——
The woman in black gauze laughed and set off a terrifying storm. The surrounding mountains continued to collapse in the storm. The scope of the storm was very wide. Xie Lianxin could not escape from the scope of the storm, so she could only use Xie Yi's sword energy again.
Her long sword erupted with dazzling light, and the sword intention surprised the woman in black gauze. The white sword light swept across, like a dragon waving its tail, and instantly crushed the storm back. The strong wind rolled back, and a scream from the woman in black gauze came from the sandstorm in the sky.
Dead or not?
Xie Lianxin tensed up.
The wind stopped, and a figure stood in the sky.
The woman in black gauze was not dead. Her upper body was torn apart from her left shoulder to her chest. Xie Yi's sword energy made her wounds unable to heal, but she was not dead either. She had just avoided the real vital point. Xie Lianxin failed to kill her with one sword, and the seriously injured woman in black gauze became furious.
"Little bitch——"
The furious demon was very terrifying. Her face was ferocious, and the pressure and air waves caused by the murderous intent that erupted from her body instantly blew Xie Lian's heart away.
Bang bang bang——
Xie Lianxin smashed through three mountain peaks, and she jumped up from the ground. She was not seriously injured because of Kunpeng Yuyi and other treasures on her body. But as soon as she got up, the furious demon was already approaching. Xie Lianxin received a punch and was knocked away again, smashing through another mountain.
This guy is stronger than the demon in the fortress, this thought flashed through Xie Lianxin's mind.
Among the demons, there are lower demons, higher demons, and above the higher demons there are demon gods. The strength of demon gods actually varies widely. Above the large and small demon gods, there is the ancestral demon god, also known as the original demon god. Xie Lianxin's grandfather was one of the most powerful original demons.
Her mother is a combination of a demon god and a great demon, inheriting one-half of the power of the original demon god. Xie Lianxin is half human, one-quarter demon, and one-quarter devil.
She inherited a quarter of the original demon god's power, but not long after she was born, the original demon god's power and a quarter of the demon power were sealed by her father.
